_provenance: Best mean spellF1 (0.792 all, 0.768 DFL; official baseline 0.291 / 0.267) of the 3-member GRU ensemble below, features v2, ATD noise without per-frame jitter, under 5-fold simulated-ATD cross-validation on 10 open matches (python -m tempolens.experiments --model ensemble). Flat for switch 2-3 (within 0.0003); switch 1-1.5 is worse; the dead-ball costs barely matter; the change-head bonus did not help.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py). Off: on the real match the tags agree with a confident model 83% (attacking codes) and 94% (defensive codes) of the time, yet the prior lowered the public-window spellF1 (0.43 vs 0.59, single GRU).
